description: Next.js GSD Foundation & Core Application Setup

userStories.title: Validate development environment and CLI dependencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to ensure jq, gh, and git are available and validated in the environment.
acceptanceCriteria: Script verifies availability of git, jq, and gh
Clear diagnostic output provided if any tool is missing
userStories.notes: Verified: jq installed, GitHub CLI installed and authenticated via OAuth device login

userStories.title: Build GSAP Fluid Kinetic Hero Section
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want an animated, fluid Hero section showcasing GSD & Ralph Loop capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive GSAP fluid particle canvas responding to cursor movements
Entrance timeline choreography with ambient gradient lighting
Live HUD card preview with interactive loop simulator
Typecheck and production build pass cleanly
userStories.notes: Implemented in src/components/Hero.tsx and mounted in src/app/page.tsx

userStories.title: Create Modern Header Navigation and Brand Shell
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a clean, responsive header with branding and navigation links.
acceptanceCriteria: Responsive navigation header located in src/components/Header.tsx
Dark mode compatible styling using Tailwind CSS
Mobile hamburger menu toggle for small screens

userStories.title: Add System Status & Autonomous Loop Dashboard Card
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see real-time status of Ralph Loop tasks and GSD milestones directly in the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Status component displaying completed vs pending stories from prd.json
Visual badges for story passes: true / passes: false
